purpose: Failure modes recorded before implementation; verify through actual CLI workflows against disposable Career-Ops code and fictional data.

failures: wrong or missing posting identity, URL, run lineage, company or role
header and body scores disagree
work authorization or evidence silently changes
duplicate or malformed Machine Summary
existing backup overwritten
report changes after prepare
path traversal
historical compact report becomes unreadable
scenarios.proof: Prepare and commit using actual CLI; valid expansion preserves immutable fields and exact backup; invalid drafts and concurrent changes leave the report tree unchanged.

failures: noncanonical scoring dimensions replace North Star or compensation
shared/custom rule sources omitted or stale
procedural rules become candidate facts
High confidence despite partial/unknown dimensions or unresolved eligibility
evidence fields disappear from persisted reports
truthful evidence truncated to fit an arbitrary cap
fresh legacy-schema results accepted
historical results mutated or unreadable
scenarios.proof: Actual acquisition fixture, planner, part validation, merger, renderer, official writer and receipt; canonical evidence and derived confidence survive persistence; stale sources and inconsistent results are rejected before persistence.

failures: code/data roots conflated
absolute or relative CAREER_OPS_PROFILE ignored, or redirected when a child changes working directory
observational scan-history rows suppress a posting, or cancel independent committed evidence
balanced parentheses in report links break publication, lookup or health evidence
environment and marker precedence diverge from official resolver
relative tracker override targets wrong directory
read and write paths or lock keys disagree
report links resolve against wrong root
preview overrides leak into real commit
resume, application, Gmail, infographic or LinkedIn consumers retain hardcoded paths
scenarios.proof: Real CLI workflows under default, marker, environment and tracker-override layouts; all outputs and indexes resolve into declared data roots, with code and unrelated data unchanged.

failures: verifier deletes stale reservation files
verifier creates directories in original workspace
symlinks or external overrides reach original files
snapshot loses warnings or rewrites report identity
missing canonical interface appears healthy
scenarios.proof: Run actual official verifier through health CLI against fixtures containing stale reservations, warning cases and alternate paths; original byte/mtime/tree manifest remains identical and warnings remain visible.

failures: blacklisted company or domain is assigned, persisted or selected for application
punctuation/case or subdomain bypass
unrelated suffix or parent/subsidiary overmatched
absent list blocks normal work
list changes after planning without recheck
override applies to more than explicitly authorized posting keys
single application bypasses batch gate
blacklist changes score or existing application state
official parser import writes files or pins plugin state
posting key and URL mismatch releases an unapproved exception
blacklist changes between planner snapshots producing a partially mutated inconsistent run
scenarios.proof: Actual scan planning/commit and application CLI preflight using official blacklist parser; matched records are held with reason, unrelated jobs continue, exact authorized exceptions remain bounded, and blacklist edits are detected before persistence/final application preparation.

failures: Career-Ops custom rules still prescribe obsolete worker-pool/full-report workflow
native and Job Discovery entrypoints use conflicting scoring guidance
repair discards unrelated user preferences or changes existing candidate facts
scenarios.proof: Diff and resolved rule-source artifacts show the current owning Skills as workflow authority and canonical scoring rules loaded; unrelated custom sections and candidate sources remain byte-identical.

failures: canonical reason misclassified or guessed from free text
missing malformed duplicate vocabulary or hash drift
fixed-term quote fabricated spliced or deleted in expansion
fixed-term prompt accidentally changes eligibility policy or score
v5 accepted for new writes or v4/v5 history implicitly migrated
new fields exceed compact budget or disappear after official persistence
healthy JD archive fixture lacks an archive while expecting success
scenarios.proof: Frozen fixtures through actual planner, validator, merger, official writers, upstream reason analytics and expansion; negative cases preserve data and historical bytes.

failures: missing/empty/duplicate/fabricated keywords
Java substring of JavaScript accepted
C++/C#/.NET corrupted by Markdown escaping
comma/newline/Markdown injection or excessive size
report total exceeds 6000 Unicode characters
historical v6 mutated or accepted for new writes
official matcher falls back or drops terms
expansion cannot read v7
scenarios.proof: Actual planner, validator, merger, official writers, receipt and upstream keyword-match CLI; retained command logs and coverage JSON; v6 read-only with unchanged manifests.

failures: missing or malformed importance list; inferred high; forged or spliced JD signals; duplicate/out-of-order requirements; silent high-importance truncation; empty and >12 high rows rejected
candidate match or importance changes global fit or report gate
lossless requirements lost in upstream parser or expansion; v7 reinterpreted as v8
ATS triple guessed from aggregate/custom/ambiguous URL or opaque case/id normalized
official compute/parser interface missing; writer drops listing_key; rollback damages unrelated history
native dedup cannot read persisted listing token
scenarios.proof: Actual planner, validator, merger, official report/history/tracker writers, receipt and upstream requirements analytics/native dedup. Fault injection, historical manifests, command logs and source hashes.
